description.value: Agra Tandoori Restaurant is a full-service Indian restaurant in Burnaby specializing in traditional tandoori preparations, curries, and fresh-baked naan. The restaurant operates two Burnaby locations and offers both dine-in buffet service and a takeout menu with a wide range of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. Touring cyclists passing through Burnaby would find it a solid option for a hot sit-down meal or a packaged takeout order.

Multiple vegetarian dishes (Dal, Channa Masala, Paneer Makhani, Vegetable Pakora, etc.) confirm vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity anywhere on the site.
